predict.question: An invented exact-match retrieval rule succeeds on three matching cues and fails on seven others. Retrieval rate?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: How We Learn discusses learning conditions and the cues available during later retrieval.
modelBoundary: Familiar context retrieves {A}%; changed context {B}%. The matching share shrinks under an exact-match rule.
